monitoring_scope: Hong Kong citywide. The map is a geographic entry to aggregate monitoring, without district-level values.

map_visuals.usage: Regional geographic orientation only. No station, district risk, street or catchment claims.
map_visuals.outline_source: Hong Kong Island polygon from this same Natural Earth dataset

analysis.display_scaling: Clinical proportions multiplied by 100 once; saved errors already use percentage points.

opening_camera: Single-map continuous zoom with overlapping island-outline reveal; shared map and outline transform
ui_theme: Light water blue; white sidebar, neutral white glass controls, white data surfaces
map_overlay_source: Hong Kong Island polygon from Natural Earth 1:10m land
glass: Pale translucent background with fine white highlights
query_transition: Map and charts contract above the rising query bar, leaving 18px spacing
subtitle_style: White text on uniform black background
presentation_style: Six labelled narrated interface pages with live query, comparison and export demonstrations
video_audio: User-provided v3 MP3; same audio source, no voice regeneration in this revision
